instruction: Create a multi-hop SSH tunnel through two jump hosts to an internal database
output: ssh -L 5432:db.internal:5432 -J bastion1.example.com,bastion2.example.com user@target.internal

instruction: Set up a full WireGuard VPN with wg-quick and NAT for a home lab
output: sudo apt install wireguard && sudo wg genkey | tee /etc/wireguard/privatekey | wg pubkey | tee /etc/wireguard/publickey && sudo wg-quick up wg0

instruction: Configure an OpenVPN server with TLS-auth and route push for all traffic
output: sudo openvpn --genkey --secret /etc/openvpn/tls.key && echo 'tls-auth /etc/openvpn/tls.key 0' | sudo tee -a /etc/openvpn/server.conf && sudo systemctl restart openvpn@server

instruction: Set up a Libreswan IPsec VPN with leftcert and rightca for mutual certificate auth
output:
echo 'conn cert-vpn
  left=192.168.1.1
  leftcert=server.crt
  right=%any
  rightca=ca.crt
  auto=add' | sudo tee -a /etc/ipsec.conf && sudo systemctl restart ipsec

instruction: Deploy a Tailscale subnet router to advertise a local LAN subnet
output: sudo tailscale up --advertise-routes=192.168.1.0/24 --accept-routes

instruction: Create an SSH tunnel that stays alive and restarts via systemd
output:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/ssh-tunnel.service << 'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=SSH Tunnel
After=network.target
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/ssh -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -L 8443:internal-web:443 -N -T user@bastion
Restart=always
RestartSec=10
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF && sudo systemctl enable --now ssh-tunnel

instruction: Build a SoftEther VPN server with L2TP/IPsec enabled for mobile clients
output: sudo /usr/local/vpnserver/vpncmd localhost:443 /SERVER /CMD IPsecEnable /L2TP:yes /L2TPRAW:yes /ETHERIP:no /PSK:mySecretKey

instruction: Create a WireGuard multi-peer configuration for a hub-and-spoke topology
output:
cat > /etc/wireguard/wg0.conf << 'EOF'
[Interface]
Address = 10.0.0.1/24
PrivateKey = <server-privkey>
ListenPort = 51820
[Peer]
PublicKey = <peer1-pubkey>
AllowedIPs = 10.0.0.2/32
[Peer]
PublicKey = <peer2-pubkey>
AllowedIPs = 10.0.0.3/32
EOF

instruction: Start an ngrok tunnel that forwards to a local HTTPS server on port 443
output: ngrok http https://localhost:443

instruction: Set up a dual-stack (IPv4/IPv6) WireGuard interface
output: sudo wg set wg0 private-key /etc/wireguard/privatekey && sudo ip addr add 10.0.0.1/24 dev wg0 && sudo ip addr add fd00::1/64 dev wg0 && sudo ip link set wg0 up

instruction: Configure a Cloudflare Tunnel with multiple ingress rules for different services
output:
cat > /etc/cloudflared/config.yml << 'EOF'
tunnel: my-tunnel
credentials-file: /etc/cloudflared/credentials.json


ingress:
  - hostname: app.example.com
    service: http://localhost:3000
  - hostname: stats.example.com
    service: http://localhost:9090
  - service: http_status:404
EOF && sudo systemctl restart cloudflared

instruction: Create a VPN-less SSH tunnel for a MySQL database with keepalive
output: autossh -M 0 -o ServerAliveInterval=30 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 -L 3306:rds.internal:3306 -N -f user@bastion

instruction: Start a FRP server with TLS encryption and custom subdomain hosting
output:
cat > /etc/frp/frps.toml << 'EOF'
bindPort = 7000
bindPortTLS = 7001
webServer.port = 7500
auth.token = "secure-token"
tls.force = true
EOF && sudo frps -c /etc/frp/frps.toml

instruction: Use socat to create an encrypted tunnel via OpenSSL
output: socat OPENSSL-LISTEN:443,cert=/etc/ssl/certs/server.pem,verify=0,fork TCP:localhost:80

instruction: Set up a ZeroTier moon to reduce latency between peered nodes
output: sudo zerotier-cli orbit 0123456789abcdef 203.0.113.5/9993 && echo 'Moon configured - nodes will now use the custom moon'

instruction: Create a WireGuard peer with dynamic endpoint updates via persistent-keepalive
output: sudo wg set wg0 peer <peer-pubkey> endpoint example.com:51820 persistent-keepalive 25

instruction: Run a Chisel client in reverse-proxy mode to expose a local web server
output: chisel client --keepalive 30s https://vps.example.com:8080 R:80:localhost:8080

instruction: Establish a P2P VPN link with Tinc between two Debian servers
output: sudo tincd -n vpn -K 4096 && sudo tincd -n vpn --config=/etc/tinc/vpn && sudo tincd -n vpn

Create a udp2raw service that auto-starts for WireGuard tunneling over TCP
output:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/udp2raw.service << 'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=udp2raw tunnel
After=network.target
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/udp2raw -c -l 0.0.0.0:3333 -r 203.0.113.5:4096 --raw-mode faketcp -k mypasswd
Restart=always
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF && sudo systemctl enable --now udp2raw

instruction: Deploy a Nebula overlay network with lighthouse and multiple nodes
output: sudo nebula -config /etc/nebula/lighthouse.yml & sudo nebula -config /etc/nebula/node.yml

instruction: Configure strongSwan to use VICI protocol for dynamic connection management
output: echo 'VICI socket: /var/run/swanctl/swanctl.socket' && sudo swanctl --stats

instruction: Set up an SSH tunnel to route all traffic through a remote server as a SOCKS proxy
output: ssh -D 1080 -q -C -N -f user@proxy.example.com && echo 'Set your browser to SOCKS5 127.0.0.1:1080'
